value.answer: Mostly overrated, I'd say, unless you're swapping out several supplements you already buy. If it replaces your multivitamin, probiotic and a few others, the all-in-one thing can actually save you money and hassle. But on its own, critics say the doses are low for a lot of ingredients, the evidence for the health claims is thin, and at roughly $79 to $99 a month it's expensive for what you get. If you're healthy and eating a varied diet, you probably don't need it. The taste gets mixed reviews, and if you take blood thinners or blood pressure meds, check with a doctor or pharmacist first, since reishi and grape seed can interact with them.
